info.title: SP UPdater
info.author: N3DSwitch
info.description: Update—all you need is your Nintendo
info.details:
A homebrew application for the Nintendo Switch featuring a white, Horizon-style interface. Download and update Atmosphere, firmware, and packs; back up your save data to the Telegram cloud; and keep your console clutter-free—all synchronized via a Telegram bot.

Multilingual support has been added to the 'Session' section.

AI use: AI-generated, not reviewed line by line. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.
